styles.text: .az573-inv{--gold:#c5a161;display:grid;gap:12px;max-width:520px;margin:auto;color:#efdfc0}.az573-inv section,.az573-inspect{padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid #6c522e;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#302619,#181410)}.az573-inv h3{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--gold);font:700 17px Georgia,serif}.az573-count{float:right}.az573-equip,.az573-bag{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px;text-align:center}.az573-equip small{display:block;font-size:10px;line-height:12px;min-height:24px}.az573-cell{width:100%;max-width:58px;aspect-ratio:1;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid var(--item,#716044);border-radius:5px;background:radial-gradient(#382b1e,#100e0b);color:#a88b5c;box-shadow:inset 0 0 6px #000;font-size:20px}.az573-cell svg{width:70%;height:70%}.az573-cell[aria-pressed=true]{outline:2px solid #e8bd68;outline-offset:-3px}.az573-cell:disabled{opacity:.65}.az573-inspect{height:120px;overflow:auto}.az573-up{color:#8ddd76!important}.az573-down{color:#ff827b!important}.az573-pick .az-candidates{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}.az573-pick .az573-comp{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:126px;min-width:0;background:linear-gradient(#392e24,#1a1713);border:1px solid #8c6b3c;padding:7px;white-space:normal}.az573-comp strong,.az573-comp small{overflow-wrap:anywhere}.az573-level{position:absolute;top:5px;right:8px;color:#ffda8f;font:700 22px Georgia}.az573-stars{color:#e8bb65}

.pop-b { background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; max-width: 520px; width: 100%; max-height: 88dvh; overflow: auto; position: relative; }

@media (orientation: landscape) and (max-height: 520px) { .qs-in { max-height: 96dvh; } .pop { padding: 8px max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-right)) 8px max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-left)); } .pop-b { max-height: calc(100dvh - 16px); } }
